description: A curated stop-by-stop walking route for a city: each stop in order with what to know there, real coordinates, distance on foot and total time. Distance excludes tram, metro and ferry legs, which are flagged separately. Nine cities deliberately have no route because a self-guided walk is the wrong format there.

hours.description: Optional route length. Only 3, 6 and 12 exist; omit to get whatever the city has.

name: walking_route
title: Self-guided walking route
